PHOENIXD_API_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated API password for phoenixd's HTTP API. LNbits references this value — do not change after first deploy.

HOST.description: Bind address for the web server.

PORT.description: Web server port. Also used by the Railway healthcheck.

LNBITS_ADMIN_UI.description: Enables the superuser admin panel at /admin (first visit to the site creates the superuser).

LNBITS_DATA_FOLDER.description: SQLite data directory on the persistent volume.

PHOENIXD_API_ENDPOINT.description: phoenixd HTTP API over Railway's private network. Auto-resolved at deploy time.

PHOENIXD_API_PASSWORD.description: Reference to Phoenixd's API password — shared secret, stored once.

FUNDING_SOURCE_MAX_RETRIES.description: Startup retries while phoenixd builds (exponential backoff, ~4 min total). Without this LNbits silently falls back to VoidWallet on first deploy.

LNBITS_BACKEND_WALLET_CLASS.description: Funding source implementation. Static — this template wires LNbits to phoenixd.
